verdict.rationale: Gitea supports extending workflows via Actions that can reuse existing GitHub Actions plugins, plus API/webhook extensibility and third-party integrations (Slack, Jenkins, Drone, Argo CD), but there is no evidence of an actual marketplace/app-store for third-party apps or AI models within Gitea itself. Missing for 10: a dedicated marketplace UI/catalog for third-party apps, no AI model marketplace or plugin store, and no independent confirmation of marketplace-style discovery beyond reusing GitHub's Actions ecosystem.
